Chapter 1282: 31: Infinite Void, Fifth Layer (2)

Chapter 1282: Chapter 31: Infinite Void, Fifth Layer (2)

These matters must be completed before mastering the “Infinite Void” Fourth Rank.

Only then can a foundation be laid before the inner universe’s groundwork is set, to facilitate the continual fusion of more source world essences in the future.

“The reason why a source world is called a source world is that it is more perfect than other worlds of the same level, closer to true perfection. My inner universe absorbing the essence of a source world will also be closer to perfection, with the hope of eventually becoming perfect.”

“A perfect world? That is a world that only a Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being can establish. Once my inner universe transforms to true perfection, the distance to becoming a Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being may not be far.”

Of course, this is just Lin Yuan’s speculation. To truly become a Fourteenth Rank Perfect Time Being? Lin Yuan does not have much clue.

A Perfect Time Being can freely roam the timeline, existing in the past, present, and future, and can even create the future they desire. Such a level of life is beyond the imagination of ordinary beings.

The Master of Wushan’s ultimate pursuit was merely to draw a picture of the source world and become a Time Lord.

As for becoming a Perfect Time Being? Lin Yuan’s only knowledge is that the premise of a Perfect Time Being is perfection.

If the inner universe truly reaches perfection, could he be close to being a Perfect Time Being?

“Take it slow.”

Lin Yuan continuously integrates the essence of the two source worlds into his inner universe.

Currently, a Perfect Time Being is still too distant for him, as he isn’t even a time being.

Rumble.

The inner universe continuously roars.

The essence is being transformed.

This transformation is different from the “Infinite Void” reconstruction.

It is the fundamental existence being changed.

Like an iron knife versus a gold knife.

Only a few hundred breaths passed.

The fundamental operation of the two source worlds completely merged into the inner universe.

In fact, Lin Yuan had long begun preparing to take the advantages and perfection of the two source worlds and integrate them into his own inner universe.

Now taking action, it is naturally fast.

“Enter the ‘Infinite Void’ Fifth Rank.”

Lin Yuan carefully perceived for a while and began the final transformation of his inner universe.

The “Infinite Void” Fifth Rank is a turning point.

Normally, cultivators advancing to the fifth level of this legacy have the power of an Invincible Great Saint.

Lin Yuan integrated the fundamental operational advantages of the two source worlds before mastering the fifth layer.

Buzz～

As the inner universe underwent its final transformation.

An invisible aura began to sweep over.

Before long.

The inner universe completed its transformation.

“The inner universe after fusion, and advancing to the ‘Infinite Void’ Fifth Rank…”

Lin Yuan again felt an increase in his own strength.

“Now, even as merely a manifestation, can I rival the Abyss Dragon?”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

The manifestation has not been cultivated.

But the inner universe is normally opened.

No match for the boundless inner universe of the true self.

The inner universe fused with the advantages of the two source worlds to perfection, along with advancing to the “Infinite Void” Fifth Rank.

Naturally, the power of the manifestation surged, completely reaching the level of the Abyss Dragon.

“A manifestation equal to an Abyss Dragon?”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head, reminiscing about the initial establishment of the first source world, which gathered endless creation and causes to birth an Abyss Dragon.

Now, a casually formed manifestation can reach this domain.

“Just right, the hope of retrieving the Magic Origin Fruit is even greater.”

Lin Yuan felt pleased.

…

Inner universe.

Beside the jade gourd.

The red-clad girl was swinging her legs.

At this moment——

An inexplicable wave swept over.

“What is this?”

The red-clad girl jumped up immediately.

“Entered the ‘Infinite Void’ Fifth Rank?”

The red-clad girl’s eyes widened, full of amazement.

Even though she already knew Lin Yuan would reach this level, it was just a matter of time.

Yet when this day truly arrived, it was still somewhat unbelievable.

The cultivation speed is really too fast.

“Infinite Void” is a thirteenth rank inheritance; not everyone can cultivate to the fifth level.

Even passing the initial test, highly compatible with this inheritance, those who can reach the fifth level are exceedingly rare.

Generally, among hundreds of inheritance cultivators, only one may reach the fifth level.

But Lin Yuan?

For Lin Yuan, it’s not a matter of whether he can reach the fifth level.

Rather, it’s the unimaginable speed of reaching the fifth level.

Making the red-dressed girl’s understanding start to shatter.

“No way?!”

Suddenly, the red-dressed girl’s expression changed.

Although the aura sweeping from within her universe is very similar to crossing into the fifth level of “Infinite Void.”

Yet after careful feeling, the red-dressed girl confirmed that this was different from the normal fifth level of “Infinite Void.”

Similar yet different.

“How is that possible?”

The red-dressed girl couldn’t believe it.

“Don’t worry.”

Lin Yuan’s figure condensed not far away, smiling at the red-dressed girl, “I just modified the ‘Infinite Void’ inheritance a bit.”

Originally, “Infinite Void” pursued the Chaos Void as the ultimate goal; now the ultimate pursuit has changed to aspire for a higher perfect world, naturally requiring revision of the cultivation method in between.

“Modify?”

The red-dressed girl fell into deeper silence.

This thirteenth rank inheritance, the masterpiece of a Time Being, is mostly unsurpassed in every aspect; even other Time Beings could not necessarily modify it, but Lin Yuan just modified it?

What made the red-dressed girl even more incredible was that the modified fifth level of “Infinite Void” faintly gave her a more magnificent, deeper feel.

This was different from Lin Yuan’s previous integration of other thirteenth rank skills.

This modification was from the inheritance’s foundation, fundamentally something else.

“Indeed.”

“I think the current ‘Infinite Void’ is more suited to me.”

Lin Yuan said with a smile; only the secret technique inheritance created by oneself can perfectly fit.

As for secret technique inheritances created by others? Even for great thirteenth rank beings, it couldn’t perfectly fit every life.

It can only relatively fit.

“Hmm…”

The red-dressed girl’s heart felt somewhat confused, but she nodded.

…

At the edge of Chaos Void.

In front of an increasingly narrowing dimensional rift.

A dozen figures stood not far away, gazing from afar at that dimensional rift.

These dozen figures were supreme saints, invited by the Eye of Myriad Laws to enter the dimensional rift to retrieve the Magic Origin Fruit.

However, now.

All the expressions of these supreme saints were immensely grave.

The dimensional rift was rapidly closing, yet their main battle bodies hadn’t withdrawn and were still battling dimensional life on that small continent within the rift.

The environment within the dimensional gap was drastically different from within the Chaos Void; even for supreme saints, they would be greatly suppressed in such a strange environment.

“This dimensional rift will completely close in at most three days; within three days, if our main battle bodies can’t return…” one of the supreme saints couldn’t help but speak.

Compared to Chaos Void, the dimensional gap was extremely dangerous; life below the thirteenth rank faces the risk of death at any moment within the gap.

Once this dimensional rift closes, it would mean the main battle bodies of these dozen supreme saints being completely trapped outside the Chaos Void, akin to total demise.

Early or late, it would happen.

Even for supreme saints, cultivating a main battle body is no easy task, requiring dedication.

“Feng Zhu, did you tell Myriad Laws about it? That Magic Origin Fruit is very hard to take away; why not let us retreat.” The second supreme saint spoke.

The dimensional rift would close within three days, and within these three days, the hope of taking back the Magic Origin Fruit was nearly zero.

In such a case, the supreme saints naturally were reluctant to continue fighting on that small continent and considered withdrawing their main battle bodies.

This way, the losses would be minimized.

“Myriad Laws said that other saints have been invited for support, there is still hope.”

Great Saint Feng Zhu spoke; he had the closest relationship with the Eye of Myriad Laws, knowing many things in advance.

“Other saints? The native lifeforms on that small continent outside the rift are extremely ferocious; no matter how many saints invited, it’s hard to retrieve the Magic Origin Fruit within three days.”

The first supreme saint who spoke whispered.

“Feng Zhu, which saint did Myriad Laws invite?”

The third supreme saint inquired, believing that the Eye of Myriad Laws had confidence since it hadn’t given up.

As these words were spoken.

All the other supreme saints collectively looked at Great Saint Feng Zhu.

“Myriad Laws said, invited…”

Great Saint Feng Zhu scanned the numerous saints and slowly said: “The Galactic Saint!”
